waived.af: Affinity 2 universal document: no public sample found. The real .afdesign covers the shared container.
waived.afphoto: Affinity Photo document: no public sample found. The real .afdesign covers the container all Affinity apps share.
waived.afpub: Affinity Publisher document: no public sample found. The real .afdesign covers the container all Affinity apps share.
waived.aftemplate: Affinity template: no public sample found. The real .afdesign covers the shared container.
waived.avci: No AVC-coded HEIF file is public: Nokia's conformance set and libheif's examples are all HEVC. The corpus sample is its real HEIC under this extension, which exercises the hook and the shared HEIF reader, not an AVC bitstream.
waived.bay: Casio RAW: absent from raw.pixls.us, rawsamples.ch and every suite searched on 2026-09-17. No sample of any kind.
waived.c4d: Cinema 4D scene: no public scene with an embedded preview found. The corpus sample is built with the real chunk layout around a JPEG preview.
waived.cap: Phase One .cap RAW: absent from raw.pixls.us, rawsamples.ch and every suite searched on 2026-09-17 (the real .iiq covers the vendor). No sample of any kind.
waived.cb7: See .cbz: a 7-Zip archive of page images, written for the corpus by 7-Zip itself.
waived.cbt: See .cbz: a TAR of page images, written for the corpus by the in-box tar.exe.
waived.cbz: A comic archive is a plain ZIP of page images written by an archiver; the corpus builds its own with a real one. A scanned public-domain comic is 25 MB or more per file for no format coverage the small one lacks; the real .cbr is a third-party RAR.
waived.dcs: Kodak DCS RAW: absent from raw.pixls.us, rawsamples.ch and every suite searched on 2026-09-17 (real .dcr, .kdc and .k25 cover the vendor). No sample of any kind.
waived.drf: Kodak DRF RAW: absent from raw.pixls.us, rawsamples.ch and every suite searched on 2026-09-17. No sample of any kind.
waived.f3d: Fusion 360 archives: none found under a stable public URL. The corpus sample is built with the real layout, zstd-compressed preview included.
waived.fl32: FilmLight's float format. Nothing written by FilmLight's own software is public; the corpus sample comes from ImageMagick, the only other writer.
waived.jnx: Garmin BirdsEye tiles are licensed per device, so no redistributable file exists. No sample of any kind.
waived.livp: A Live Photo bundle (a zip of the HEIC and the MOV) only comes out of a phone app's export and none is public. The corpus sample is built with that layout around the real HEIC.
waived.odf: LibreOffice Math writes an empty thumbnail into every formula file, so a real .odf draws as a blank tile. The corpus sample carries a drawn thumbnail in the same package layout; the real .odt, .ods, .odp and .odg cover the reader.
waived.phm: Portable half-float map: ImageMagick is the only writer in circulation; the corpus sample is its output.
waived.phz: See .cbz: a ZIP of images under a second extension; the corpus copy is its .cbz.
waived.procreate: Procreate (iPad) document: none found under a stable public URL. The corpus sample is built with the real package layout (QuickLook/Thumbnail.png).
waived.pspframe: Paint Shop Pro picture frame: these ship only inside Corel's installers. The real .pspimage, .psp, .tub, .PspBrush and .PspTube files cover the reader they share; a renamed one would prove nothing about a frame.
waived.pspmask: Paint Shop Pro mask: ships only inside Corel's installers. See .pspframe - the shared reader is covered by five real PSP-family files.
waived.pspselection: Paint Shop Pro selection: ships only inside Corel's installers. See .pspframe - the shared reader is covered by five real PSP-family files.
waived.pspshape: Paint Shop Pro preset shape: ships only inside Corel's installers. See .pspframe - the shared reader is covered by five real PSP-family files.
waived.ptx: Pentax PTX RAW: absent from raw.pixls.us, rawsamples.ch and every suite searched on 2026-09-17 (the real .pef covers the vendor). No sample of any kind.
waived.pwp: PhotoWorks album: no public file found. The real .sfw covers the picture format inside it, and the album wrapper has its own unit test.
waived.pxn: Logitech Fotoman RAW: absent from raw.pixls.us, rawsamples.ch and every suite searched on 2026-09-17. No sample of any kind.
waived.rmf: Raw Media Format: absent from raw.pixls.us, rawsamples.ch and every suite searched on 2026-09-17. No sample of any kind.
waived.sf3: Simple File Format family image: no third-party file found; the corpus sample is ImageMagick's output.
waived.xd: Adobe XD document: none found under a stable public URL. The corpus sample is built with the real package layout (the sparkler mimetype plus thumbnail.png).
waived.xlsb: Excel embeds a thumbnail only when asked, and no public .xlsb carries one. The real .xlsx and .xlsm cover the package reader they share.
waived.xyze: Radiance XYZE: no public file found. The real .hdr covers the shared reader; the corpus sample is ImageMagick's output.
